description: Set the shared pull reference used by core/cavity, side actions, and mold draft. mode auto searches icosphere and planar candidates, minimizing occluded undercut area and then maximizing drafted area. mode plane uses Top (+Z), Front (+Y), or Right (+X). mode face uses normal [x, y, z] in the part local frame and keeps its sign. Changing it recomputes those three from the same pull. Read-only. It does not edit CAD draft.

mode.description: auto searches. plane uses an origin plane. face uses normal.

normal.description: Face normal [x, y, z] in the part local frame when mode is face. The sign is kept.

plane.description: Origin plane when mode is plane. Top is +Z, Front is +Y, Right is +X.

name: mold_pull
